consequence.statement: The connected-state metric is reported under the new name, so monitoring that still queries envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_control_plane_connected_state no longer receives it.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards and alert rules to query envoy_cilium_npds_control_plane_connected_state instead of envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_control_plane_connected_state.

assertion.statement: In Cilium 1.17's \"Changed Metrics\" upgrade notes, the metric `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_control_plane_connected_state` is renamed to `envoy_cilium_npds_control_plane_connected_state`.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: exposure depends on whether the environment's monitoring (dashboards, alert or recording rules, external scrapers) references the old metric name, which none of this product's configuration sources (helm values, cilium-config, CiliumNodeConfig, agent/operator flags) or supported predicates read, and the evidence states no condition
